CustomField.description: API name of the Agent Tool Type record this tool runs, such as UpdateRecord. The tool type supplies the Apex class and decides how Core retries and recovers the tool.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the API name of an Agent Tool Type record in Custom Metadata Types: QueryRecords, CreateRecord, UpdateRecord, RunFlow, RunFlowWithExternalEffects, PostChatter, or a custom type your developer registered, such as one from the Agent Tools package.
CustomField.label: Tool Type
